cohort: 4,990 healthy children aged 2-14 years attending an outpatient clinic in Istanbul, Turkey
finding: Increased birth weight and maternal BMI were significant risk factors for obesity in children, while caesarean section delivery, breastfeeding duration, and timing of solid food introduction were not associated with childhood obesity.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was not significantly associated with childhood obesity.
birth_weight: Birth weight greater than 3801 g was associated with increased risk of obesity
